title: How Making His Bed Trains a Godly Man to Run the Rest of His Day
caption:
A godly man wins the day before 7 AM. One bed, made or not, tells him which man showed up.

Whoever is faithful in very little is also faithful in much (Luke 16:10). Self-control isn't a switch you flip at the big moment. It's a muscle you load in the small one.

The man who governs the bed governs the browser. One kept promise makes the next one easier to keep. The bed, then the workout, then the phone at 9 PM. Same man, same muscle.

He didn't win the day at noon. He won it before he stood up.

#faith #christianmen #manofgod #discipline #selfcontrol #mornings
theme: He runs his life — his impulses don't control him.
